short: A pivotal battle of the Anarchy resulting in the capture of King Stephen.
full:
On 2 February 1141, the forces of King Stephen clashed with an army loyal to Empress Matilda outside the city of Lincoln. Stephen had been besieging Lincoln Castle, which had been seized by rebel barons, when a relief force commanded by Robert, Earl of Gloucester, arrived. The royalist army was outnumbered after several of Stephen's prominent supporters fled the field during the initial cavalry engagements.

Stephen refused to retreat and fought on foot until his sword and battleaxe were broken and he was physically overwhelmed. His capture temporarily shifted the balance of the civil war entirely in Matilda's favour. She briefly assumed control of the country, but her failure to secure London and her subsequent defeat at the Rout of Winchester led to Stephen's release later that year in a prisoner exchange.
